summary: Kaniksu National Forest lookout: a 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, dated 1933 and destroyed 1955; no source describes what remains on the peak.

events.note: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with L-4 cab; a separate 35-foot patrol tower with a log cabin on Green Mountain is described without a date

evidence.supports: built 1933 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower
separate 35-foot patrol tower with log cabin on Green Mountain, 1.5 miles SSW
evidence.quote: Also 35' patrol tower with log cab atop Green Mtn. 1.5 miles SSW.

evidence.supports: 14 miles southwest of Bonners Ferry, Boundary County
separate patrol tower with log cabin atop Green Mountain
evidence.quote: Patrol Tower with log cabin atop Green Mtn

evidence.supports: Dodge Peak listed under Boundary County

notes_for_editor: Height is left out: '30' pole' is the pole length, and neither source states a tower height. The 35-foot patrol tower on Green Mountain has no date in either source, so it appears in the story but not in events. The 5,027-foot elevation is on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. The two pages use close wording, so they may share one source. Staffing is left out: no source gives a staffing history. Only two pages describe the lookout itself, so confidence is medium.
